svg.title: Finite point gluing and the missing second extension classes
svg.desc: Three point stalks A1, A2, A3 map by u1, u2, u3 to the common constant module M on the complement. For the Picard-zero K3 surface over rational coefficients, the full complex-constructible heart has zero second extensions after every finite refinement, while ambient second self-morphisms of the constant sheaf form rational dimension22. This is a categorical diagram, not a geometric picture of a K3 surface.

g.text: Ordinary sheaf gluing for three exceptional points
Every finite point refinement has a length-one projective resolution.
The realization functor misses these degree-two morphisms.
